high_level_description: This image is a promotional graphic for LEGO Group's new recycled plastic brick prototypes. The background is a solid light blue color, which creates a clean and modern aesthetic. The central focus of the image is a large, vertical arrangement of small white plastic bricks that form the shape of a bottle. These bricks are scattered and layered to give the appearance of a bottle with a cap on top. The text at the top of the image reads: "LEGO Group’s new recycled plastic brick prototypes spell green for the toy company.
